item.title: Super Spline Studios is hiring Lead 3D Games Animator – Permanent (Remote Job)
item.description: Lead 3D Games Animator – Permanent Europe Remote, Or Leamington Spa Office We are looking for a Lead Animator with practical knowledge of game development. You will be leading projects and working alongside the animation team to create believable high-quality character animations. A strong understanding of the principals is essential with a keen eye for adding character and personality to your work. You will be able to project manage, liaise with clients and manage multiple animators and their workload. • Have a minimum 7 years industry experience in video games, freelance experience a bonus • Create high quality, hand keyed character, creature and environmental animations. • Lead and collaborate with other disciplines to ensure the animations works as intended in the game. • Exceptional self management skills. • Manage / mentor internal and external animators. • Be pleasant to work with, communicate well, understand briefs, meet deadlines. • Be accountable & responsible, a clear communicator and problem solver • Ability to adapt and work with new technologies and workflows. • Ability to switch up styles from cartoony to realistic • Experience working with motion capture data and leading shoots • Capable of creating schedules and committing to delivery dates. • In depth knowledge of Maya and have an understanding and experience with rigging and skinning • Ability to implement your work in engine, working with state machines and other related concepts. • Experience with multiple game engines and multiple shipped titles. Experience in Unity and UE4/5 advantageous. • Be a team player, open to take and offer feedback. • Constantly strive to learn new / improved tools, techniques and processes all while honing your core craft. • Attend awesome events. • Have the desire to help make awesome games
